params.prompt: professional e-commerce product photo of a brushed stainless steel insulated tumbler with a screw lid, brushed stainless steel with fine horizontal grain, on a seamless light grey background, large softbox key light, even illumination, subject about 50% of the frame with even margin on all sides, sharp focus, high detail, commercial grade, 8k
params.negative_prompt: low resolution, blurry, out of focus, deformed structure, distorted outline, wrong proportions, extra parts, missing parts, melted edges, watermark, logo, text in image, cluttered background, floating without support

notes: 中 denoise：在保真与换光之间取折中。⚠️ 参考图在离线校验里由**桩 resolver** 提供，不证明素材能被引擎读到
